evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic equivalence stated as bedrock — identity-level operational creed, not an argued position; the directive above it operationalizes the same creed.
Settled cadence stated as operational fact — the speaker has decided and expects others to comply; no hedging or alternatives voiced.
Ownership assignment is a performed ratification — settling who acts, not arguing for it.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityYouDoNotHave
mints.title: a capability you have not rehearsed is a capability you do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the conviction here entering as an identity-level equivalence that treats rehearsal as constitutive of the capability itself?
